precondition: unique source-order evaluation/expansion path for successful bare mat positional, named and spread occurrences

variants.transform: evaluate the first successful positional occurrence twice before constructing Args
evaluate the successful named delimiter occurrence before the preceding positional occurrence
drop the middle item while expanding an arguments spread without changing non-spread evaluation
reverse only the expanded spread items before common construction

killer_witnesses.M16a-duplicate-success: successful signal contains pos-1 exactly once
killer_witnesses.M16d-reorder-spread: spread repr retains a,b,c source order

validity: All four variants must be killed. Error short-circuit observations alone are not valid count evidence; duplicate/reorder variants require the successful mutable-array signal and spread variants require the separate successful spread witness.
